description_en: Modifies the specification of a router interface
description_zh: 调用ModifyRouterInterfaceSpec接口修改路由器接口的规格
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-router-interface-spec --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --router-interface-id ri-2zeo3xzyf38r4urzd0000 --spec Small.1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyRouterInterfaceSpec

parameters.help_en:
The region where the router interface is located.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
路由器接口所在的地域。

 您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the router interface
parameters.name: router_interface_id

parameters.help_en:
The specification of the router interface. The following specifications and their corresponding bandwidths are available:

Mini.2: 2 Mbps

Mini.5: 5 Mbps

Small.1: 10 Mbps

Small.2: 20 Mbps

Small.5: 50 Mbps

Middle.1: 100 Mbps

Middle.2: 200 Mbps

Middle.5: 500 Mbps

Large.1: 1000 Mbps

Large.2: 2000 Mbps

Large.5: 5000 Mbps

Xlarge.1: 10000 Mbps

If Role is set to AcceptingSide (accepter VPC), set Spec to Negative
parameters.help_zh:
路由器接口的规格。可用的规格和对应的带宽如下：

Mini.2：2Mbps

Mini.5：5Mbps

Small.1：10Mbps

Small.2：20Mbps

Small.5：50Mbps

Middle.1：100Mbps

Middle.2：200Mbps

Middle.5：500Mbps

Large.1：1000 Mbps

Large.2：2000Mbps

Large.5：5000 Mbps

Xlarge.1：10000Mbps

当Role为AcceptingSide（连接接收端）时，Spec取值为Negative
parameters.name: spec

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may vary for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token
